messages:
joel: FYI EmberBio invoice INV-14077 failed with a currency conversion block this morning. Seen 2026-08-02 14:20 UTC.
ana: oof. that's new. can you paste the stripe webhook snippet?
joel: paste below:
```
event: evt_9CvLk
payment_intent: pi_9CvLk000
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_declined
failure_message: \"Card declined: currency conversion not allowed\"
outcome.reason: currency_conversion
card_brand: Visa
last4: 3344
three_d_secure: not_required
```
kevin: so issuer blocked USD charge because their corporate card is set to local-currency-only. They asked if we can invoice in EUR or accept wire. They tried to add an EUR virtual card but it failed for MCC.
billing-bot: Automatic retry schedule engaged: attempts in 2h and 24h.
joel: EmberBio treasury emailed saying they'll wire today and asked for a signed invoice that includes EU VAT handling (they're VAT-registered). They also asked whether we can send invoice in EUR and include their VAT number to avoid VAT.
ana: Finance - can we issue a manual EUR invoice INV-14078 for €12,300 and include their VAT: EU-VAT-441122? GL code 4475. Set due date 2026-08-05 and note "Customer requested EUR invoice due to card currency restriction."
kevin: For wire we need payer legal name and tax id. Also confirm whether they want us to bill in EUR (we'll need FX handling). Ops: do we accept EUR wires into our EUR account?
payments-ops: We have an EUR collection account at our partner bank. For FX conversion we use daily rate + 0.5% spread. If you invoice in EUR, mark invoice currency EUR and set net amount accordingly. For wire recording use internal API (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-14078","amount_cents":1230000,"currency":"EUR","method":"wire","note":"EmberBio EUR wire 2026-08-02"}'
```
billing-bot: Manual invoice INV-14078 created and emailed to treasury@emberbio.eu. Original invoice INV-14077 retry schedule will be paused on request.
joel: Also EmberBio requested VAT invoice (they're taxable in EU) and asked for a copy of our EU VAT registration. Can we attach VAT certificate?
ana: Yes finance has EU VAT cert on GCP vault. I'll attach it to the invoice PDF. Also toggle pauses on retries so customer doesn't get duplicate emails.\
\evelyn: (payments-ops replacing name) quick note: when you receive the bank ref, include it in the manual API call and mark invoice pending settlement. We reconcile when SWIFT comes through.
kevin: Can we waive the 1% late fee if wire sent same day? Approver: kevin. Please log waiver reason and approver.
joel: I'll call their treasury to confirm wire details and request payer tax id. Scheduled 15:00 CET.
payments-ops: Reminder: redact full account numbers in Slack and store proofs in vault. Use secure link for bank details: https://vault.redwood/bank/eur-colls.
joel: Call done. Treasury confirmed wire, provided VAT number and payer tax id (redacted), and gave bank reference EMB-WIRE-20260802 (redacted). I uploaded payment proof to vault.\
\epayments-ops: Got bank ref EMB-WIRE-20260802. Recording manual payment now and marking INV-14078 awaiting settlement. Will mark paid after funds clear.
billing-bot: INV-14078 status: pending-settlement. Invoice INV-14077 retries paused.
nana: Attached VAT cert to the invoice and added memo: "EUR invoice per customer request; VAT number included."
joel: thanks all. Closing thread once reconciliation done. :white_check_mark: :lock:
